risk_note: RV2 by path (platform/config, infra/staging). Staging-only test phone numbers with a fixed code (approvals 48, D10-611): only with APP_ENV=staging, a listed number's login / step_up code is generated and stored as usual but not handed to the SMS channel, and verification also accepts the fixed code read from a node file; landing registration and bind are excluded. Blacklists, captcha / device limits, the four per-phone limits, IP and daily budget, expiry, 5 wrong attempts and single use are unchanged. Any other APP_ENV with either variable refuses to start, and construction refuses too. The code and full numbers never reach logs, responses or the pino audit line. No amounts.

Static, nothing executed.
